specification.description: Compute y[i] = (x[i] + a[i]) * b[i]; fuse two elementwise stages.
specification.semantics: Exact real arithmetic; four-byte data words in a single-device two-level model.
conditions: Inputs are independent and initially in slow memory; output is fully written to slow memory.
Split stages materialize the intermediate vector; fused stages keep the temporary in fast storage.
Ignore caches, address calculations, synchronization and spills; reserve four data words per active element.
